qualitative.note: Fails Gate 1 (Rejected – G1 Understandability). Opaque accounting disclosures, labyrinthine related-party governance structures involving family-controlled vehicle Scranton Enterprises NV, dual-consolidation of plasma assets (Haema, BPC Plasma), and disputed true leverage fail Charlie Munger's circle of competence and external verifiability standards.
qualitative.evidence: Despite holding a strong position in plasma fractionation and plasma-derived therapies, Grifols' reported financials violate the Gate 1 verifiability test. Investigations triggered by Gotham City Research reports and subsequent CNMV regulatory reviews revealed complex related-party financial structures, call-option sale-and-leaseback mechanisms with Scranton Enterprises, and non-transparent adjustments that masked actual leverage (estimated real net debt/EBITDA of 10-13x versus stated ~6x).
